title: kith-store: all schema migrations
description:
Define all table and index DDL for the kith-store schema in a single migration string.

**What:** SQL DDL for all seven tables (self, contacts, chats, chat_members, messages, outbox, attachments) and all indexes, as migration version 1.

**Algorithm:**
1. Write SCHEMA_V1: &str containing CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS statements for:
   - self(tailscale_user_id TEXT PK, tailscale_login TEXT NOT NULL, display_name TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
   - contacts(peer_user_id TEXT PK, peer_login TEXT NOT NULL, peer_mailbox_host TEXT NOT NULL, display_name TEXT, first_seen_at INTEGER NOT NULL, last_seen_at INTEGER NOT NULL, blocked INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)
   - chats(id TEXT PK, kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'direct', created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, last_message_at INTEGER)
   - chat_members(chat_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chats(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, peer_user_id TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(chat_id, peer_user_id))
   - messages(id TEXT PK, chat_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES chats(id), sender_user_id TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, body_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'text/plain', sent_at_peer TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, delivery_state TEXT NOT NULL, delivered_at INTEGER, read_at INTEGER, reply_to TEXT REFERENCES messages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL)
   - outbox(message_id TEXT PK REFERENCES messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, peer_user_id TEXT NOT NULL, peer_mailbox_host TEXT NOT NULL, next_attempt_at INTEGER NOT NULL, attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_error TEXT)
   - attachments(id TEXT PK, message_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES messages(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, filename TEXT NOT NULL, content_type TEXT NOT NULL, size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL, sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
2. CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS messages_chat_time ON messages(chat_id, created_at)
3. CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS messages_pending ON messages(delivery_state) WHERE delivery_state='pending'
4. CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS outbox_next ON outbox(next_attempt_at)
5. Include state_counters(type_name TEXT PK, counter INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0) table for JMAP state tracking
6. Register as MIGRATIONS entry: (1, SCHEMA_V1)

**Defensive programming rules:**
- Use CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for all tables (idempotent)
- Use CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS for all indexes (idempotent)
- All FK references include ON DELETE behavior (CASCADE or SET NULL)
- CHECK constraint: delivery_state IN ('pending','delivered','failed','received')
- No raw string interpolation anywhere in SQL

**Tests:**
- After migration, PRAGMA user_version = 1
- All 8 tables exist (query sqlite_master)
- messages_chat_time index exists
- messages_pending partial index exists
- outbox_next index exists

**Acceptance:** cargo test -p kith-store: migration tests pass; all 8 tables present in in-memory DB; clippy clean.
